parsed.post: Significant improvement! val_bpb dropped from 1.006835 to 0.998614. The combination of DEPTH=8, MATRIX_LR=0.06, and 5% warmup is working well. Moving to test ASPECT_RATIO increases to see if higher resolution context improves the bitrate.
parsed.description: Increase ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to test if higher resolution/context improves validation bits per byte.
